name: Red-Blue Shuffle
justification: Statement has a probability story to digest, but the symmetry insight collapses it to a two-counter loop.
solution_sketch: R>B is decided by the first position (in shuffled order) where digits differ; by symmetry each card is equally likely to be that first differing position. So just compare count of i with r_i>b_i vs r_i<b_i.
